# Bharti Airtel Limited

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-29 · status **partial** · Budget for documents/searches largely spent; the 257-page combined Integrated Report was paged partially but the statutory CSR Annexure-A section was not located within budget, so csr_year figures for FY2024-25 rely on a news secondary source (medium confidence) rather than the primary annexure; FY2022-23 and FY2023-24 csr_year figures were not found at all; PAN/CSR1/Darpan identifiers and named contacts were not found.

Bharti Airtel Limited (CIN L74899HR1995PLC095967) is a Section 135-bound listed telecom company. FY2024-25 BRSR confirms CSR applicability and gives aspirational-district CSR spend across 7 districts in Jharkhand, Meghalaya, Punjab and Jammu & Kashmir, plus beneficiary counts for four named CSR projects (Supporting Partnered Govt. Schools, Satya Bharti School Punjab, Plaksha University scholarships, School of Future Technologies at Anant National University). A secondary news source (India CSR) supplies FY2024-25 CSR obligation/spend figures (prescribed ₹60.741 crore, spent ₹30.682 crore direct, ₹16.6 crore unspent-transferred) and program detail (Satya Bharti School Program, Quality Support Program, Bharti Scholars Program, Rural Acceleration Programme) attributing implementation to Bharti Airtel Foundation, the Bharti Enterprises philanthropic arm. Note found: the BRSR aspirational-district spend table's unit label ('In ₹ K') appears inconsistent with total company CSR spend and is flagged rather than silently converted. No csr_year data found for FY2022-23 or FY2023-24; no PAN/CSR1/Darpan identifiers found; no named contacts found. Nxtra Data Limited's FY2020-21 CSR annexure (an Airtel subsidiary) was also fetched but is out of the requested year range and not saved as findings.

## CSR position by year

- **prescribed csr ₹60.74 cr (CSR Obligation (as per Companies Act) ₹60.741 crore before set-off) · spent on projects ₹30.68 cr (Direct CSR Spend by Airtel Ltd ₹30.682 crore in FY 2024-25) · unspent transferred ₹16.60 cr (Unspent CSR Funds ₹16.6 crore transferred to ongoing projects account (e.g. School of Future Technologies)) · excess spent ₹13.63 cr (Rs 47.115 crore after adjusting ₹13.626 crore excess from prior years)** (FY2024-25)
  > The company's CSR obligation for FY 2024-25 was calculated based on 2% of its average net profit... which amounted to Rs 60.741 crore. However... Airtel was entitled to set off an excess contribution of Rs 13.626 crore from previous years... Out of this, Bharti Airtel Limited spent Rs 30.682 crore directly on CSR projects during the year. The remaining shortfall of Rs 16.6 crore has been... transferred to an unspent CSR account for ongoing projects.
